mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS id, slug, visibility, status, BIN_TO_UUID(current_published_version_id) AS current_published_version_id, created_at, updated_at, row_version

BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS id, BIN_TO_UUID(problem_id) AS problem_id, version_no, status, code_mode, title, statement_markdown, input_description_markdown, output_description_markdown, constraints_markdown, hint_markdown, difficulty, CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) AS tags_json, BIN_TO_UUID(test_data_version_id) AS test_data_version_id, change_summary, created_at, updated_at, published_at, row_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM problem WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
SELECT FROM problem WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id IN UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) ORDER BY problem_id, version_no DESC
SELECT FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId})
SELECT FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT language_id, display_order, starter_code FROM problem_version_language WHERE problem_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) ORDER BY display_order
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problem_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_FOR_REVIEW')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem (id, slug, visibility, status, current_published_version_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at, row_version) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{problem.id}), #{problem.slug}, #{problem.visibility}, #{problem.status}, UUID_TO_BIN(#{problem.currentPublishedVersionId})NULL, UUID_TO_BIN(#{createdBy}), #{problem.createdAt}, #{problem.updatedAt}, #{problem.rowVersion})

INSERT INTO problem_version (id, problem_id, version_no, status, code_mode, title, statement_markdown, input_description_markdown, output_description_markdown, constraints_markdown, hint_markdown, difficulty, tags_json, checker_type, test_data_version_id, change_summary, created_by, published_by, created_at, updated_at, published_at, row_version) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{version.id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{version.problemId}), #{version.versionNo}, #{version.status}, #{version.codeMode}, #{version.title}, #{version.statementMarkdown}, #{version.inputDescriptionMarkdown}, #{version.outputDescriptionMarkdown}, #{version.constraintsMarkdown}, #{version.hintMarkdown}, #{version.difficulty}, #{version.tagsJson}, 'DEFAULT', UUID_TO_BIN(#{version.testDataVersionId})NULL, #{version.changeSummary}, UUID_TO_BIN(#{createdBy}), NULL, #{version.createdAt}, #{version.updatedAt}, #{version.publishedAt}, #{version.rowVersion})

INSERT INTO problem_sample (id, problem_version_id, ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}), #{ordinal}, #{inputText}, #{expectedOutputText}, #{explanationMarkdown})

INSERT INTO problem_version_language (problem_version_id, language_id, display_order, starter_code, judge_template) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}), #{languageId}, #{displayOrder}, #{starterCode}, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE problem SET slug = #{slug}, visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}

UPDATE problem_version SET title = #{version.title}, statement_markdown = #{version.statementMarkdown}, input_description_markdown = #{version.inputDescriptionMarkdown}, output_description_markdown = #{version.outputDescriptionMarkdown}, constraints_markdown = #{version.constraintsMarkdown}, hint_markdown = #{version.hintMarkdown}, difficulty = #{version.difficulty}, tags_json = #{version.tagsJson}, change_summary = #{version.changeSummary}, updated_at = #{version.updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{version.id}) AND problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{version.problemId}) AND status = 'DRAFT' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId})
DELETE FROM problem_version_language WHERE problem_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId})
DELETE FROM problem_version WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) AND problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE problem_version SET status = 'DRAFT', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE status = 'VALIDATING' AND updated_at < #{cutoff}

UPDATE problem_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = UUID_TO_BIN(#{actorUserId}), published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = #{publishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) AND problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status = 'READY_FOR_REVIEW' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET current_published_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_audit_event (id, problem_id, problem_version_id, actor_user_id, action, trace_id, detail_json, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemVersionId})NULL, UUID_TO_BIN(#{actorUserId}), #{action}, #{traceId}, #{detailJson}, #{createdAt})
